messages:
Maria: FYI — Acme opened a billing dispute for the March window. Dashboard shows ~108k streaming tokens; invoice charged ~141k. Assigning triage.
Jake: that gap is large. can you share a sample request id + any session logs?
Maria: account=acme-inc; sample_req=acme-314159; model=rw-13b; stream=true. customer reports many mid-stream client cancels. logs uploaded to s3.
Ryan (Acme): correct, our client cancels about 15-20% of streams due to UX timeout. we expect cancellations to stop billing immediately.
Lena: pulling billing feed. dashboard total=108,312; invoice feed total=140,987. i see a cluster of short-lived streams around 2026-03-02T14:20Z.
OpsBot: replay logs available at s3://redwood-replays/acme-inc/2026-03-02/14/ (keys: acme-314159.log, acme-314160.log)
Jake: paste a trimmed SSE snippet from acme-314159.log please — want frame vs final events.
Maria: snippet from acme-314159.log:

``
-> request start id=acme-314159 model=rw-13b stream=true
event: token_frame
data: {"tokens":"Hello", "count":1}
event: token_frame
data: {"tokens":" world", "count":2}
# client disconnected at t+1.6s
# server retried final flush
event: token_frame
data: {"tokens":"!", "count":1}
event: finalize
``

Jake: i see the pattern. our runtime emits live per-frame meter events, then emits a finalization event on flush. if the finalization is retried after a dropped connection we currently produce a new event with a different event_ts. dashboard dedupes by request_id; billing ingestion dedupes on (session_id,event_ts) -> duplicates get included in invoices.
Lena: confirmed in billing feed: two rows for request acme-314159 at 14:22:12 (count 3) and 14:22:13 (count 1). dashboard collapsed to total 3; invoice summed both -> 4. small delta per request but multiplies across many cancels.
Jake: root cause hypothesis: retry path emits a new finalization row instead of reusing an idempotent finalization event id. fix options: (A) emit idempotent finalization with idempotency_key=request_id, (B) annotate retries (retry=true) so pipeline can ignore duplicates, or (C) change billing dedupe to collapse on request_id.
Lena: short-term remediation: i'll run a reconciliation job for the invoice window that dedups billing rows by request_id and compute a manual credit. starting job now.
Ryan (Acme): ETA for reconciliation and when we can expect a credit? please CC our billing contact billing@acme.com.
Lena: estimate ~90-120 minutes for reconciliation scan. preliminary token credit ~32k tokens; finance will convert to USD and apply manual credit. opened finance ticket FT-2026-0421.
Jake: engineering plan: i'll add producer-side changes to (1) emit finalization with idempotency_key=request_id, (2) add meter_event_type=frame|final and retry boolean, and (3) unit tests to assert billing idempotency. PR will be up today; aim for canary deploy in 24h and prod after validation (~72h).
Maria: repro notes / runbook steps for SRE:
- reproduce with a dev client that opens SSE and closes the connection after n frames (simulate UX timeout).
- induce a server-side final flush retry (drop ACK path) to force duplicate finalization emission.
- tail billing_feed.topic to confirm duplicate event rows for the same request_id.
Quick reproducer (dev):
``
CURL_PID=$(curl -N -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" -d '{\"model\":\"rw-13b\",\"stream\":true}' https://api.dev.redwood/v1/generate?key=TEST & echo $!)
sleep 1.7
kill -9 $CURL_PID
``
Jake: telemetry change: emit meter_event_type and idempotency_key; set retry=true for subsequent attempts. billing ingestion should dedupe on idempotency_key when present or ignore retry=true events.
Lena: reconciliation job running. i'll post results and the exact token credit number when complete.
Maria: owners: Jake -> eng fix + PR, Lena -> reconciliation + finance credit, Maria -> customer comms. Ryan, i'll DM you progress and CC billing@acme.com as requested.
Ryan (Acme): thanks, appreciate the quick triage.
FinanceBot: finance ticket FT-2026-0421 created, pending reconciliation output for credit.
Maria: noted. will write a short postmortem after reconciliation + rollout. :thumbsup:
